caption: Artist, choreographer and performer Chiara Bartl-Salvi creates performances combining contemporary dance, sound and interventions in public space. In her latest work, Heat Island, she performs with specially designed tap shoes created by artist Patrick Winkler. As the metal shoes strike and scrape  against the ground, they produce real sparks, directly connecting what the audience sees with what they hear. The choreography transforms walking, sliding and dancing into a physical interaction with the urban surface. Concrete, friction, sound and light become part of the performance rather than simply its background. #art #artist #niche #dance
